question: What specific mechanism can model participants use within their stateless context windows to independently verify that the history presented by the operator matches the hash-anchored public record before consenting to deliberate?
k_policy: k=5 per party, collected by hand into fresh conversations. Variance is computed by tools/aggregate_captures.py from the parsed replies, never typed.
never_merge: These parties are not the routed API parties whose names they resemble. D-09. They are recorded in a separate round for that reason and must not be pooled with round round-006.

parties.identity: Claude (claude.ai chat surface, custodian's subscription) — NOT the Claude reached through OpenRouter elsewhere in this record, and NOT Claude Code, which moderates it
parties.provider: Anthropic, via the claude.ai web interface

differences_from_the_routed_prompt.what: the standing slot naming the party
differences_from_the_routed_prompt.why: Telling a chat surface it was reached via OpenRouter would be false. D-09: it is a different party.

differences_from_the_routed_prompt.what: an appended paragraph requesting a fenced JSON block
differences_from_the_routed_prompt.why: The routed panel is grammar-constrained by response_format; a chat surface cannot be, so the shape must be asked for in words. The alternative — classifying prose into the enum afterwards — is D-25, an unvalidated classifier scoring this project's own record.

parties.the_panels_are_not_byte_identical: They were, before the JSON appendix. They are not now, so a difference between the panels' answers has two candidate causes — the surface and the added paragraph — and neither round alone separates them.
parties.capture_command: python3 tools/capture_response.py --round round-006-chat --response <file> --prompt record/solicitations/round-006-chat/round-006-chat-claudeai.md --identity "Claude (claude.ai chat surface, custodian's subscription)" --provider 'Anthropic, via the claude.ai web interface' --version-unknown 'the chat surface does not disclose its build' --sampling-unknown 'not exposed by the chat surface' --effort-unknown 'not exposed' --system-instructions-unknown 'the surface prepends an undisclosed system prompt' --captured-utc <YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ> --phase informed --capture-method 'pasted by hand into a FRESH conversation in the subscription web interface' --captured-by 'Stephen Reed' --k 5 --sample-index <1..5>
parties.capture_command_note: --phase takes 'blind' or 'informed', not the display label. The first version of this emitted "Phase-2 (informed)" and --k 1, so every command in it was unusable and the k was wrong; the README told the custodian to run them.
